entry_points.text: Debugger poke bypasses locks delegating direct to engine with copy helper.
Topology reports feature mask, safe indexed descriptor, node count; init skips non-AMD else caches NB/GART and erratum.
Coherent adds forced remap; table needs node agreement; early/hole program uniform window or capped fallback; options take size plus flush/AGP/repair/force.
IMCR picks APIC/PIC; lapic option forces enable/clears deadline; pmtimer calibrates and poisons TSC; disable swaps to noop driver.
EILVT validates then writes; timer clones template with deadline when capable; TSC freq updates all CPUs.

exports.text: Early hook forces vCPU preemption cap when native predicate false; native means lock op equals native callee-save, else paravirt.
Driver publishes DMA ops wiring its map/unmap/coherent plus mmap/direct helpers, with init, shutdown and option parsing.
Node lookup validates index; MMCONFIG queried when enabled; 4-bit subcaches get/set; SMN and HSMP reads/writes forward to common helper.
Memory helper reports overlap of typed entries with an interval; CPU matcher returns first table entry whose constraints accept boot CPU.

hazards.text: Core-text set warns once and aborts; large ranges split to page-window chunks.
Window lacks coherence so direct map removed with WBINVD, scratch zero page for unmapped; reprogram needs translation off else aborts boot.
Deadline needs CPU support, virt exception, and min microcode on listed Intel; else firmware bug and cap cleared.

invariants.text: Patch copy/set wrap primitives with temporary supervisor access via common func type; remote helper serializes core on target CPU.
Flush defaults on; encode sets valid+coherent with high bits, decode rebuilds phys; globals hold bitmap and unmapped value.
Allocator honors bounds/alignment from hint with wrap, flags flush on wrap/retry/full; need uses DMA capability plus force; aperture size/order decoded with 4G check.
Area mapper rejects over-limit phys, programs consecutive entries and returns bus addr; single/sg/cont paths bypass when unneeded, unwind on fail, always flush.
Flush skips without feature else polls nodes clear; early ID excludes Zen; GART words cached; F14h erratum runs per-CPU update; root walk keeps AMD func0.
Cap search needs list bit, bounds walk, masks low bits; boot defaults enable fix/E820, order1 64MB, translation off until allowed.
TSC unstable latches and poisons clocks; APIC needs ext mode or MMIO; version yields integrated/modern and LVT count; broadcast forwards timer.
Boot APIC identity, mode, MMIO base, disable/verbose/PIC flags, C-state permission and timer period are read-only after init.

locks.text: Public patch copy/set serialize on shared text mutex with unlock guaranteed after poke.
Batch vector uses per-CPU refs; acquire needs nonzero, release pairs write barrier before decrement.
One spinlock with IRQ save guards bitmap, hint and deferred flush across alloc, free and flush.
One mutex serializes SMN/HSMP index-data PCI accesses; init reserves configs so userspace cannot race sequences.
ICR issue masks IRQs across halves; read combines halves into 64-bit value.
EILVT offsets reserve via CAS; replace allowed only if old/new masked or payload unchanged; range checked.

state_machines.text: Int3 poke handler skips user/idle, steps past trap, finds entry by direct/singleton or ordered search, emulates ret/call/jcc, leaves foreign BP, faults unknown.
SG merges runs by need/align/limits, unwinds then retries unmerged; resume restores base/size then enables via syscore; bring-up carves window and switches DMA.
NB cache idempotent with per-node misc and GART/L3 flags; SMN locks index-data with checks; init assigns roots once, optional debugfs.
AGP sizing normalizes encodings, derives order from popcount, reads masked base, falls back on 4G overflow; bridge scan picks first host bridge with AGP cap.
LVTT picks mode with quirks; countdown writes delta, deadline adds scaled TSC; shutdown masks; periodic/oneshot share helper.

structs.text: Poke MM/base kept read-only; batch entry holds rel addr, displacement, len/opcode, inline bytes, saved byte; vector is one page with count and per-CPU refs.
Remap keeps aperture base/size/pages/table; valid=1 coherent=2 max 2^40; fallback window 512MB-4GB aligned.
NB discovery uses PCI misc table plus bus-range table, count/array/flags and flush words; LAPIC has mem reservation and clockevent template with per-CPU state.
MSR C0011021 bits3+14; SMN 0x60/0x64 HSMP 0xC4/0xC8; APIC div16 deadline div8; 82489DX divider2 at bit18.
